title: Enterprise Live-Commerce SaaS Chatail Raises $10M Series B Led by Qiming
summary: On Jul 22, 2022, enterprise live sales & service SaaS Chatail (founded Aug 2017) closed a $10M Series B led by Qiming Venture Partners, with Cathay Capital following — 3rd round (angel Jun’21, A Oct’21) — for CS upgrade and AV-live / client-ops / sales-growth teams. 1:1 / 1:few
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 28, 2022

On Jul 22, 2022, enterprise live sales & service SaaS Chatail (founded Aug 2017) closed a $10M Series B led by Qiming Venture Partners, with Cathay Capital following — 3rd round (angel Jun’21, A Oct’21) — for CS upgrade and AV-live / client-ops / sales-growth teams. 1:1 / 1:few / 1:many live for fashion, jewelry/watches, beauty, auto, 3C; clients include LVMH, Kering, Richemont, L’Oréal, Estée Lauder brands. LIVE Button / Instant Call as public→private entry; LIVE Invitation >90% attendance, apparel conversion ~70%; Mobile LIVE on WeCom for store associates.

— END —
